other_conditions: Applicant must be a native of Rajasthan.
Applicant must be studying in a government school or college.
Applicant must have passed class 10th to graduation with a first division.
If pursuing postgraduate studies, applicant must have obtained at least 48% marks in the first year and be enrolled in the final year.
Applicant must belong to one of the Special Backward Class communities: Banjara, Baldiya, Labana Gadia‑Lohar, Gadoliya Gurjar, Gujjar Raika, Raibari (Debasi).
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹3,500 per year per student.
